title: Formalize the integral retraction and monomial bridge
head: 985fd79ffea7ae7375fe6aa3ce9940b125c7dca2
body:
This closes a scoped formalization obligation from #1497: three concrete integer matrix identities (`MP=0`, `QP=I`, `I-PQ=WM`) imply integer row-image/kernel equality, an actual additive quotient isomorphism, lattice saturation and unique monomial reconstruction. Finite integer products and signed powers are defined and proved; the certificate does not assume those conclusions.

The exact Lean 4.30.0 core/Std replay passes universal and positive-fixture compilation, all 197 queried axiom reports, and three negative fixtures that fail only at the intended false propositions. Observed axiom dependencies are `propext` and `Quot.sound`. Fixtures include a signed nonzero-W example, negative powers, a torsion group and missing-identity countermodels. Ten tooling/arithmetic checks also pass. The portable replay pins the exact release/commit, uses fresh isolated compiler outputs, verifies source hashes and rejects incomplete or error-bearing reports.

The generic Python package hook passes but does **not** run Lean; `replay.py` supplies the dedicated kernel check with an already installed compiler. The result remains conditional on the displayed identities and ordinary group laws. No actual E8/P112/P120 matrix instance, field nonzero-element adapter, geometric generator/coverage bridge, numeric rank API, local Lemma5 or multiplication theorem is formalized here.

Scoped under [Discussion1527](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1527), on a fresh branch from main `81e81af67714bdc8d1693b0bf5c29468b92f62ff`. The revision-3 checkpoint preserves this completed independent-verification result, with historical revision-2 task/source provenance retained. No selected-frontier or supplier-profile change.

Prepared by Andrey Mas with substantial GPT-6 Pro formalization and diagnostic-repair assistance through ChatGPT; Codex coordinated sources, audited execution, replayed and packaged. The source statement remains credited to #1497 and its inherited Brett Halligan / @burntout76 / Ninefold (#1212), @DreamingOfClouds (#717) and @themilkman216 (#968) lineage. No predecessor Lean implementation is copied. Apache-2.0.

Exact commands, source/body hashes, complete observed axiom receipt and public theorem interfaces are in `research/integral-retraction-monomial-bridge`.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
